{{Quote|Now boarding star commuter shuttle ST-45, bound for Garel.|Lothal spaceport dispatcher|<ref name="Droids in Distress" />}}
'''ST-45''' was a [[Star Commuter 2000]] [[transport]] [[shuttle]] that ferried passengers between the neighboring [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]]s of [[Lothal]] and [[Garel]]. The shuttle was piloted by [[R-3X|RX-24]], a [[RX-series pilot droid|RX-Series pilot droid]]. The [[Spectres|rebels]] who operated on Lothal traveled from Lothal to Garel aboard the shuttle during their [[Mission to steal Imperial weapons|mission]] to steal [[T-7 ion disruptor rifle]]s from the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Droids in Distress" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
ST-45 appeared in "[[Droids in Distress]]," the first regular series episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.<ref name="Droids in Distress" /> The shuttle was based on the original incarnation of [[Star Tours/Legends|''Star Tours'']], a [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] theme park attraction. In ''Star Tours'', [[RX-24/Legends|RX-24]] is depicted as the pilot of [[Star Tours Flight 45]] (ST-45), onboard a [[StarSpeeder 3000]] spacecraft.<ref name="DiD Trivia">{{SW|url=series/droids-in-distress-trivia-gallery|text="Droids in Distress" Trivia Gallery}}</ref> For "Droids in Distress," the shuttle was designed by series artists [[Pat Presley]] and [[Jim Moore]].<ref name="DiD Concept Art">{{SW|url=series/droids-in-distress-concept-art-gallery|text="Droids in Distress" Concept Art Gallery}}</ref>
